title: Responsibility for violations.
officialText:
Notwithstanding any provision of this section, only the holder of a certificate of operation shall be liable for violations of this article that relate to such holder’s obligations regarding security guards.
*§28-117.4.3 Enforcement. In addition to employees of the department, employees of the police department and the department of consumer and worker protection shall have the authority to enforce the provisions of this article regarding security guards.
*Section 28-117.4.3 was amended by Local Law 80 of 2020. This law has an effective date of August 28, 2020.
